Cut: the S->N crossing over an SRAM row is c->tx 1,043 + rx->SRAM/skid ~1,024 = 2.07 k bits vs 4.95 k M5 tracks over the 237.6 um width (M1-M4 blocked over the 174 um macro; the two 31 um side channels add M2-M4) = 0.42 <= 0.60; pin faces 2,052 (S) / 2,089 (N) pins on 4.95 k M5 tracks = 0.42.
